synthesis:draft.headline: SA five‑minute RRP peaked at 4,981.0 $/MWh at 2026-07-31 02:05 ACST (interval end) [ev0433].
summary: The five‑minute RRP peak was 4,981.0 $/MWh at 2026-07-31 02:05 ACST (ev0433).
The high‑price episode comprised 214 five‑minute intervals at or above the $300.0/MWh analysis threshold (214 intervals: ev0966; threshold: ev0967).
Mean five‑minute RRP across the window was 416.71 $/MWh (ev0883).
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at the five‑minute price peak was 1,472.82 MW (ev0434) and net interchange at that peak was −82.59 MW (net import) (ev0435).
Operational demand in the half‑hour ending 2026-07-30T17:00:00Z (2026-07-31 02:30 ACST) was 1,466.0 MW (ev0910); the window maximum operational demand was 2,173.0 MW (ev0895).

possible_explanations.statement: Local generator output reductions or limited availability may have contributed to tighter supply.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve generator outage/availability declarations, rebid logs and unit offer/dispatch records for the DUIDs with SCADA changes (e.g. those with evidence ev0937, ev0940, ev0946, ev0949, ev0952) and compare timing and offered availability to dispatch outcomes.

possible_explanations.statement: Interconnector transfer limits or the invoked S‑TBSE constraint set [market_notice_144697#0] may have reduced import capability and supported higher local prices.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve interconnector capability time series and constraint binding reports (S‑TBSE) for the window and compare capability and constraint binding with the actual net interchange time series (including ev0435).

possible_explanations.statement: The City West transformer trip reported by AEMO [market_notice_144692#0] might have affected operations earlier in the day.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check dispatch constraint activations, rebid logs and any subsequent outage/declaration records after the transformer trip notice [market_notice_144692#0] and compare dispatch patterns and constraints.
